# R14a fixtures (synthetic)

All R14a data are generated by `tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py::four_group_sets` (seeded standard-library
Gaussian values; no study data). Groups A, B, C and D have five independent units each. B-A and C-A share the A units;
B-A and D-C share none. The planted, hand-labelled features are in `SETS_PLANTED`: concordant-up F01-F02,
concordant-down F05-F06, discordant F09-F10, B-A only F03-F04 and F07-F08, C-A only F11-F12, and D-C up F03-F04 and
F13-F15. Features F01 and F02 carry the same gene identifier, so protein-group and unique-gene counts differ. On seed 8
the primary limma families recover exactly the planted features at q < 0.05.
